text:
kevin: Proposal: add a 'phased lock' onboarding tier to the catalog. Purpose: give customers a safe, observable path to lock a model version while we finish validation and migration tooling. Need concrete acceptance gates, TTL rules, and a canary/runbook.
anya: I like a named tier. Two quick asks: 1) make the default low-friction (allow fallback under load), 2) provide an explicit strict-lock for enterprise customers that disables fallbacks.
tiago: For acceptance gates, suggest measurable thresholds: regression delta <= 1.5% on golden set, paired A/B with p<0.03 for quality checks, cost delta <= +5% (tokens+infra), latency P95 delta <= +20ms on our 300-token median profile.
sam: Ops: canary plan idea: start with 0.5% traffic for 12h, evaluate, then 3% for 36h, then 10% for 48h before wider rollout. Prewarm step mandatory before moving beyond 3%: synthetic prefix replay to new instances. Target cache hit >= 60% and steady CPU/GPU < 80%.
kevin: On TTL, propose a short default 60-day lock with auto-review at 45 days. Auto-renew only if no regressions and customer hasn't opted out. Show renewal in Console and send an opt-out email 7 days before expiry.
anya: Migration runway: provide a 90-day grace window for non-locked customers after GA migrations. Also include a per-tenant 'migration pause' toggle so CS can delay cutover during sensitive windows.
emily: Benchmarks: require 8k mixed prompts (public tenants + 4 customer-provided examples), with splits for short (<=64), medium (65-512), long (512+). Must pass across buckets and across streaming vs non-streaming paths. Include cold start bucket for 1-2 shot cases.
tiago: Add compatibility checks: embedding vector stability (cosine drift < 0.03 median), tokenizer round-trip parity, and top-k sampling sanity checks for stochastic models. These are blockers for a strict-lock.
sam: Rollback triggers to codify: absolute error rate increase >1% or relative error increase >200%, sustained P95 increase >40ms for 15+ minutes, or GPU utilization >90% for 20+ minutes. Also require synthetic probe failures 2x in a row to initiate rollback.
ops-bot: Note: reserved canary window on 1714100000 for phased-lock infra tests.
kevin: Comms: create an in-console banner template + email sequence for pilot customers. Offer 45-day discounted lock credits to early adopters and one free migration assist for enterprise pilots.
anya: UX: show 'lock health' card in Console with per-version perf deltas, benchmark pass/fail, TTL and renewal action. Also add a 'request strict lock' flow requiring an enterprise approval step.
tiago: Technical: pinning creates multi-version routing. Ensure tracing includes version id in spans and aggregator metrics key by version. Also add a per-version KV cache namespace to avoid cross-version pollution.
emily: Action items: 1) Tiago to write perf & cache prewarm steps for runbook, 2) Sam to add rollback thresholds into paging rules, 3) Anya to draft Console UX mock and renewal flows, 4) Kevin to draft comms + incentive copy.
kevin: If no objections by EOD Thursday we'll lock acceptance gates and start infra work. Keeping this thread as canonical for gate feedback. :rocket:
